title: Hero Tower Climb
description: Outcalculate every floor in viral number-battle tower puzzles—drag your knight to defeat weaker monsters, absorb their power, and slay the top boss.
controls: Drag your hero into enemy rooms with lower power numbers to absorb their strength and clear the entire tower.

zh-CN.title: 勇者爬塔
zh-CN.description: 买量顶流数字战力策略勇者爬塔：精算每层怪物战力，拖动勇者先吃弱怪疯狂叠加战力数值，一路横扫屠龙登顶！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动勇者进入战力比自己低的房间消灭怪物叠加数值，步步变强击败顶层大 Boss。
